verdict.rationale: First-party docs say chat answers are grounded in your sources with clear in-line citations. Hovering a citation shows the full quoted text, and selecting it jumps to the quote's location in the source so you can check it in context. Citations stay clickable when a response is saved as a note. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that citations are accurate and cover every substantive claim, and evidence of citations in generated artifacts such as audio or video overviews and reports.
